scope: Post-hoc saved-data mechanism triage, not a new causal intervention or matched-field comparison.

definitions.switch: Completed boundary before first update starting at/after cutoff. Whole crossing update retains the earlier mode.
definitions.eventDiagnostics: Boundary/facet/width diagnostics are after relaxation before surface advance; event attached list and geometry are after surface advance. Do not conflate these times.
definitions.snapshot: Boundary-only spatial samples at recorded ages, not full fields; different row snapshot times are not a shared-age comparison.
definitions.selectedDemand: Recorded kinetic fill demand, not deposited mass or physical uptake.
definitions.comparison: Own-switch geometry and diagnostic associations; no attribution to geometry alone. Different actual switch times and states are explicit.

pairs.scope: Each own actual switch, not identical absolute times or fields.
